brief:
Netanyahu is living in a state of panic, according to a former adviser to the Israeli prime minister, the Ma'an news agency reported. The unnamed adviser did not elaborate on the nature of the concerns or specific circumstances prompting the assessment.

The characterization reflects ongoing criticism of Netanyahu's leadership during Israel's military operations in Gaza, which have faced international scrutiny and domestic political pressure over the scale of civilian casualties.

title: Netanyahu's former adviser says premier lives in panic
